content.text: The Open Championship takes place at Royal Portrush in Northern Ireland from 17-20 July.
The American golfer Xander Schauffele, who triumphed at Royal Troon in Scotland in 2024, is the reigning champion of The Open.

Excitement will be heightened as Rory McIlroy, a Masters champion who has won the Grand Slam, represents Northern Ireland. Additionally, this is the location where Shane Lowry, an Irishman, achieved a remarkable Open win in 2019.
